testCases.title: Successful login with valid registered credentials
steps: Navigate to CineBook Pro login page
Enter valid email alice@cinebook.com and password Cinema@123
Click Sign In button
Verify Now Showing movie catalog loads with 6 movies
testCases.expectedResult: User is authenticated and redirected to the Now Showing movie catalog.

testCases.title: Reject invalid or empty login credentials with error message
steps: Navigate to CineBook Pro login page
Enter invalid credentials wrong@cinebook.com / badpass
Click Sign In button
Verify login error alert is visible and user remains on Login page
testCases.expectedResult: Authentication fails with a visible error banner and access is denied.

testCases.title: Filter movie catalog accurately using search query
steps: Sign in with valid credentials
Type "Quantum" into the movie search input
Click Search button
Verify only 1 matching movie ("Quantum Horizon") is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: Movie list filters down to exactly Quantum Horizon.

testCases.title: Inspect movie details metadata and proceed to showtime selection
steps: Sign in and locate Interstellar Odyssey in movie list
Click View Details for movie ID 1
Verify title, synopsis, and Select Showtime button are visible
testCases.expectedResult: Movie Details displays full movie metadata and active Select Showtime CTA.

testCases.title: Disable sold-out showtime while allowing available screening selection
steps: Sign in and open showtimes for Interstellar Odyssey
Verify sold-out showtime ST-103 button is disabled
Click Choose Seats on available showtime ST-101
Verify 10x10 seat map renders
testCases.expectedResult: Sold-out showtime is non-selectable and available showtime opens the seat map.

testCases.title: Select two available seats and verify dynamic counts and total price
steps: Open seat map for Interstellar Odyssey (ST-101)
Verify initial available count is 86 and booked count is 14
Select seats C1 and C2
Verify selected count is 2, available count is 84, and total price is $28.00
testCases.expectedResult: Seat counters update accurately and total equals 2 × $14.00 = $28.00.

testCases.title: Prevent selection of pre-booked seats on the 10x10 seat map
steps: Open seat map for ST-101
Inspect pre-booked seat A1
Verify seat A1 is disabled and cannot enter selected state
testCases.expectedResult: Pre-booked seat remains locked in booked state with selected count 0.

testCases.title: Enforce maximum 6 seats limit when attempting to select a 7th seat
steps: Open seat map for ST-101
Select 6 available seats: C1, C2, C3, D1, D2, D3
Attempt to click a 7th available seat D4
Verify seat limit error message appears and selected count remains 6
testCases.expectedResult: 7th seat selection is rejected and max-6 seat error alert is shown.

testCases.title: Reject invalid credit card number and CVV on payment checkout
steps: Select seats E1 and E2 on ST-101 and proceed to payment
Enter invalid card number "1234" and CVV "9"
Click Pay Now
Verify payment error message is displayed and booking is not confirmed
testCases.expectedResult: Payment validation rejects invalid card details and keeps user on checkout.

testCases.title: End-to-end movie ticket booking displays confirmation reference and total
steps: Sign in as alice@cinebook.com
Choose Interstellar Odyssey and showtime ST-101
Select seats F1 and F2 and proceed to payment
Submit valid mock card details and verify booking confirmation reference CB-* and $28.00 total
testCases.expectedResult: Confirmation banner and booking reference ID starting with CB- are shown.

testCases.title: Boundary test allowing exactly 6 seats with accurate total calculation
steps: Sign in and open Quantum Horizon showtime ST-201 ($12/ticket)
Select exactly 6 seats: G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6
Verify selected count is 6, total is $72.00, and Proceed to Payment is enabled
testCases.expectedResult: Upper boundary of 6 seats succeeds with $72.00 total.

testCases.title: Filter movies by Animation genre and roundtrip movie details navigation
steps: Sign in and select Animation from genre filter
Verify Skyward Chronicles is displayed
Open Movie Details and return to catalog via Back to Movies
testCases.expectedResult: Genre filter isolates Skyward Chronicles and navigation roundtrip succeeds.
